name: shipflow
description: Autonomous issue-to-PR pipeline. /ship-task picks up (or cuts) a GitHub issue, reproduces it, routes it by blast area (express, full, or epic), drafts and adversarially reviews a plan, implements with routed multi-reviewer panels and fix rounds, runs build/lint/test/acceptance gates, and opens a mergeable PR. Runs on Claude Code, on Codex, or hybrid (Claude orchestrating GPT seats). Tracker state lives behind one adapter (scripts/tracker.mjs) so it can be pointed at any PM platform.
